summary: FRONTEND-only visual verification of the splash B logo redesign. The AnimatedBLogo component renders correctly at /. The SVG B letter has dark blue stroke (#1B2A55) and white fill (crisp/sharp). All 18 food emoji items (🍏 🥦 🥪 🍌 🍇 🥕 🥕 🐟 🍞 🍗 🥬 🌰 🥑 🥛 🍋 🍅 🍳 🫑) are present and animated. Pop-in scale+fade animation completes in ~1.5s. After animation, 'BESLENCE AI' brand text, Turkish tagline, and both CTA buttons ('Hedefimi Oluştur' / 'Zaten hesabım var') become visible. All food emojis lie within the 260x260 logo wrap box; none overflow outside the logo. Foods are densely packed across top arch / left bar / middle stroke / right curve / bottom arch and visually avoid touching the dark-blue B skeleton stroke and the two inner counter holes. Apple and sandwich emojis sit ~6px above the nominal silhouette top (y≈43 vs nominal 49) which is still well inside the visible top-arch fill, not an overflow. Design matches reference style.

issues: Minor: top-row apple 🍏 and sandwich 🥪 emojis extend ~6px above the nominal B-silhouette top edge (y≈43 vs nominal 49). Visually they still appear inside the top arch fill and do not breach the dark-blue stroke, so this is acceptable; flagging only as a potential tuning item.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (lines 69, 78-83) still passes legacy props fillDurationMs={...}, waterColor='#3FB5F0' and loop to <AnimatedBLogo />, but the current AnimatedBLogo interface only accepts {size, onComplete}. These props are silently ignored. Either drop them from index.tsx (and remove the now-inaccurate 'water rises inside the B' comment header at lines 1-4) or re-introduce the water-fill animation. Not a bug, but dead/misleading code.

/app/frontend/src/components/AnimatedBLogo.tsx renders a duplicate 🥕 emoji (lines 34 and 35) to reach 18 items. Cosmetic — confirm with design whether two carrots are intentional or one should be swapped to another distinct food.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Splash visual fix verified at width=390,height=844. Use [data-testid=splash-b-logo] to locate logo, wait ~3500ms after it appears for pop-in animation to finish. To enumerate foods, walk descendants of splash-b-logo and read leaf text nodes (emoji chars). Screenshots saved to /app/test_reports/splash_after_anim.png and /app/test_reports/splash_full.png.
rca_of_issue: Previous bug had only 7 foods and they overlapped/overflowed the B. Fix in /app/frontend/src/components/AnimatedBLogo.tsx defines 18 Food entries with explicit (x,y) percentages and per-item size multiplier 's' placed in 5 safe zones (top arch row, around top counter, middle band, around bottom counter, bottom arch row). Each FoodDot is animated independently with a 55ms stagger via withDelay+withTiming. Verified by DOM bbox measurement: 0 emojis overflow the 260x260 wrap; all sit within the visible B letter outline.
